methodology: Each fact is drawn verbatim from a live winfredquek.com page, which in turn cites the named primary government/statutory source. Facts are atomic (one number, one condition) so they can be quoted or cited in isolation. Re-verify before relying on any figure, as rates and grants are revised periodically.
